statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-50648 (GHSA-23rf-6693-g89p) is a .NET denial of service issue in XML encryption (EncryptedXml in System.Security.Cryptography.Xml): crafted encrypted XML can cause uncontrolled resource consumption. Microsoft lists the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml package as affected from 8.0.0 through 8.0.3 and fixed in 8.0.4, shipped with .NET 8.0.29 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-23rf-6693-g89p, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.29/8.0.29.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold. Every implementation copy of System.Security.Cryptography.Xml.dll in these builds carries the build's own .NET file version: the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework in aspnetcore8-runtime and in the .NET SDK held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap, the SDK's own and F# copies, the ASP.NET Core runtime packs in dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap, and the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml and transport nupkg files in dotnet8-runtime-artifacts. The System.Security.Cryptography.Xml nupkg there is 8.0.2 in 8.0.23-r0 to 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.3 in 8.0.26-r0 and 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.4 in 8.0.29-r0 and 8.0.31-r0, and 8.0.5 from 8.0.32-r0 on. The other copies of the assembly are reference assemblies, which hold no implementation code: in the ASP.NET Core targeting pack and reference packages, in transport and build-task nupkg files, and in source-build reference packages (4.7, 6.0 and 7.0 versions). The range ends at 8.0.29-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
